mapper.select: SELECT id, target_type, symbol, code6, exchange, name, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM mkt_industry_application_target_catalog WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY target_type ASC, symbol ASC

SELECT id, target_type, symbol, code6, exchange, name, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM mkt_industry_application_target_catalog WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND symbol IN
#{symbol}
ORDER BY symbol ASC

SELECT id, target_type, symbol, code6, exchange, name, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM mkt_industry_application_target_catalog WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt_industry_application_target_catalog ( id, target_type, symbol, code6, exchange, name, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{value.id}, #{value.targetType}, #{value.symbol}, #{value.code6}, #{value.exchange}, #{value.name}, #{value.source}, #{value.remark}, COALESCE(#{value.createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{value.updatedAt}, now()), NULL ) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET target_type = EXCLUDED.target_type, code6 = EXCLUDED.code6, exchange = EXCLUDED.exchange, name = EXCLUDED.name, source = EXCLUDED.source, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, updated_at = now(), deleted_at = NULL
